reviews.review: This game was great, I played quite a bit and beat everything on the hardest modes, I aced all the achievements, then they introduced endless mode as a way to give the game mode content after they leave it. The endless mode is the most unbalance piece of ♥♥♥♥ I have every played, It doesn't ramp up even a little bit. This mode makes the game 2x harder than its hardest difficulty right out of the gate and instead of fighting 1 bullet hell boss at the end of each stage you fight 2. The would be fine if they were actually balanced for this, but they aren't, its a ♥♥♥♥ way to send the game out.
112hrs well spent sad there are no more updates but im excited to see what they come up with next
Risk of Rain but with big robot dudes.

Picture this... It's the apocalyptic future and you're some oiled up, beef cake of a robot mid work out, when suddenly a little girl with numerous advanced engineering degrees hands you a gun and orders you to kick the ass of some evil, week ass robots. What's a robot to do? Say no?! Didn't think so.

Now kiddo, when a 'Tony Hawk Pro Skater' and a 'Borderlands' love each other very much they make this sweet lovechild of a game. One with a wicked visual style, a huge arsenal of quirky guns, and a scoring system so hard it's basically a disappoint your parents simulator. You'll be hooked dunking on those bots just to get that sweet letter 'S' on your screen.

Lock in and pick your favourite colour of robot, each of 'em with their own rad playstyle, there's a flavour for everyone! I'm not allowed to tell you which one is the best or most enjoyable, you gotta make up your own mind there. But saying the orange one is the goat is just unfair to the others, wait...
 
Have you got an itch for movement based shooters? This game's gonna scratch it! 
Got an itch from something else? See your doctor!

Anyway where was I... that's right, Movement! This game has got it! 
I'm talking running, jumping, sliding, double jumping, sliding on rails, a jet pack, a damn grapple hook, heck there's even TRIPLE JUMPING. Holy smokes that's sick! Makes Apex Legends feel like a slow turned based game from the 90's, not sorry.

Also there's a variety of perks, a small quest line to justify numerous replays, and a banging soundtrack for the first 10+ hours of your robot genocide till you bust out your own spotify playlist. 

Listen, just grab your damn brobot and play this phenomenal roguelite FPS, its a fun time and the developers really poured their human hearts into it.

8/10
